'''Pkihantri''' was a location<ref name="Galladinium" /> in the [[Pkihantri system/Legends|Pkihantri system]],<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the site of a [[Pkihantri Rebel base|Rebel Alliance base]]. At one point, an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Unidentified SB-20 Slicer Droid|SB-20 Slicer Droid]] played a key role in retrieving information before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Attack on Pkihantri Rebel base|attacked]] the base.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pkihantri was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
